question.html:
Over 60 elements, apart from hydrogen, have been identified in the composition of the Sun.

a Explain how elements present in the Sun are identified. [2]

b The temperature of the surface of the Sun is 5780 K. Calculate, in nm, max for the spectrum of the Sun. [1]

c Planets and comets orbit the Sun. Distinguish, with reference to their orbits, between planets and comets. [1]
